summary: Adds an "Import..." button to the Preferences → CAM → Assets → Machines panel that opens a new MTConnect import dialog, fetching a probe document from an agent URL or a saved XML file and opening the resulting Machine in the Machine Editor for review and saving.

pages.reason: Path/Tool/assets/ui/preferences.py: Machines button row gains 'Import...' between Add and Edit, with tooltip 'Create a machine from the probe document of an MTConnect agent'; new import_machine handler opens MTConnectImportDialog then MachineEditorDialog

Machine/ui/mtconnect_import_dialog.py: new 'Import Machine from MTConnect' dialog (URL or probe XML file, /probe appended to bare host URLs, device picker when agent lists several machines, 'Machine Imported' summary of imported/assumed/not-imported items); Machine/models/mtconnect_import.py: what the import populates (axes, limits, velocities, spindle rpm band, coolant, units, machine_type) and the rotary-chain assumption recorded in kinematics notes

Machine/ui/editor/machine_editor.py: editor now accepts an unsaved in-memory machine (import path) so a machine can originate from an MTConnect probe rather than New/template; mtconnect_import.py writes 'Import assumptions:' into kinematics.notes and a provenance line into description, both visible on the Machine tab
Path/Tool/assets/ui/preferences.py hunk only touches the Machines group of the Assets page; the Machines section here is a pointer to the machine pages and its text stays correct

meta.title: CAM: Add mtconnect import to machine editor
